scope: CPU offline actual-p13-pose original-mesh static transplant and sensitivity only; no production write, no GPU, no git; GT never policy input
sample_timing: final_state_before_close: post final action, physical sample corresponding step5865; telemetry last pre-step5864

pre_dock_turn.source: actual A end q with original full collision support points; low components only matter for wall contact; excluding mesh cooked margins

limits: Original visual object vertices + original robot collision support mesh/extents are used; original cooked PhysX hull/contact/rest offsets are not reconstructed.
Robot q-based rigid joint tree misses solver constraint deformation: gripper reconstruction error above measures only endpoint consistency, other link errors unrecorded.
All standoff cases transpose actual p13 pose to a hypothetical bucket pose preserving recorded base height/roll/pitch. No navigation, bucket interaction or release was recorded.
20mm follow threshold constrains root translation over a chosen window, not object angular slip; mesh orientation changes require separate checks.
17mm old odometry endpoint error is retrospective evidence, not a bound for future transport, turn, stopping, slip or yaw.
Free drop may translate, rotate, collide and rebound; static radial inclusion does not prove delivery.
The .98 inner-circle margins are nominal circumradius-only; polygon-inradius margins are the sufficient all-azimuth replacement.

lower_inside_bin_D_candidates.scope: Hypothetical rigid retention of ACTUAL final p13 T_gripper_object during NEW unexecuted lowering; no physical hold/clearance claim

limitations: Nominal IK/path samples do not cover loaded tracking error, dynamic deformation, slip/rotation, contact offsets or all between-sample geometry.
Keep body at the checked standoff with tangent heading and establish payload-inside margin BEFORE any below-rim motion.
Opening finger sweep (to70mm) and postrelease arm unloading are not simulated; their sweep must be separately audited.
Candidate desired arm motion should derive from public measured q/FK, while T_gripper_object and mesh are offline evidence only.

recommendation.first_mobility_trial: A-hold in bucket exterior, bounded .10-.20m move and brake, measure public velocity/odometry and offline payload full-mesh follow; no GT steering
recommendation.lowering_trial_order: after independently confirming C payload is inside bucket opening, first z_body=.35, then consider=.25; retain original limits/gates and verify actual loaded motion
recommendation.do_not_use_zbody005: arm_link5 wall exclusion is uncertified even in nominal sampled geometry
recommendation.do_not_open_based_only_on_20mm_root_gate: 20mm root translation does not bound angular slip or corresponding vertex motion
recommendation.required_delivery_evidence: same object actual entry and retention after release, original objects_in_circle event and no original failure; point may occur while still held at low D and is insufficient for physical release by itself
